topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Oh my gosh, I can't believe you found him! I mean, seriously, what are the chances? You've been talking about Olly for years, how he was your rock, your best friend, and then he just... disappeared. And now, here he is, all these years later, waiting for you at a yard sale of all places! It's like coming full circle, but in this really magical, unpredictable way. I know this sounds crazy, but maybe, just maybe, this is a sign. A sign that you're exactly where you need to be. Can you imagine the stories you two could finally finish telling each other? The memories, the laughs, the tears... I'm just so, so, so happy for you right now. You’ve got to grab him, okay? No questions asked.
